status: frozen case-construction rules; final model and analysis preregistration pending
sampling_method: Polars 1.31.0 seeded hash priority of frozen source row IDs, within user and calendar role, case ID breaks hash ties
case_id: bucket number shifted left 32 bits plus zero-based row index in hash-bound prepared interactions file
known_users: all eligible cases within shared calendar
unseen_users: same case IDs restricted to user_role_code == calendar_role_code
history: strictly earlier available timestamp bundles; current bundle and unavailable feedback excluded
target: recorded is_click, interface-dependent click or valid-play feedback; no psychological interpretation
release_policy: raw case features, identifiers and targets remain private on Modal; only permitted aggregate evidence exported
scoring: none during case construction; final predictive models and analyses must be frozen before test scoring
